earlier_scan.note: Glottolog retired elpa1240 in 2012 as non-existent ('based on a misunderstanding'); no language, no sources

sources.citation: Stresemann, Erwin. 1918. Die Paulohisprache: ein Beitrag zur Kenntnis der amboinischen Sprachengruppe. 's-Gravenhage: Nijhoff. xxiii+243 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: About PAULOHI, not 'Elpaputih': §2 p.3 'Da die Worte des Paulohi mit verschwindenden Ausnahmen (cf. § 11) Paroxytona sind' (penultimate stress; already the catalog statement for paul1238). On the name: p.240 n.1 'Was Ribbe in seinen Wörterlisten als Elpaputisprache ausgibt, ist ein Gemisch aus ost- und westseranesischen [scanned: westscranesischen] Elementen' -- the only 'Elpaputih language' ever recorded is Ribbe's 1890s wordlist, which Stresemann already judged a mixed list.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.1 languoid pages elpa1240, amah1245 (Amahai), paul1238 (Paulohi)
sources.note: elpa1240: 'Retired (bookkeeping)', points to amq Amahai and plh Paulohi, no references. amah1245 refs (from): Stresemann 1927, Collins 1982/1983, Taber 1996, Taguchi 1989, Kotynski 1989 -- all type 'overview', none descriptive. paul1238: Stresemann 1918 grammar (already in catalog).

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority. 2011. Change Request Number 2011-181: retire [elp] Elpaputih (adopted 2012-02-03). Submitted by Matthew Connor (Wycliffe Asia Pacific), supporters J. Richards, K. Anderbeck. 5 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on stress. p.2 §3(c): 'There is no evidence that the language exists'.. 'Neither of the surveys [Collins 1977-79, Taguchi 1985-88] report any language by the name of Elpaputih. There are two languages on the Elpaputih Bay which may have been included in the Elpaputih language amq (Amahai), plh (Paulohi).' p.4: Collins told Anderbeck Elpaputih was another name for Paulohi; Taguchi assumed it was a cover term for the Elpaputih Bay languages. Error traced to Voegelin & Voegelin 1977.

sources.citation: Collins, James T. 1983. The historical relationships of the languages of Central Maluku, Indonesia. Pacific Linguistics D-47. Canberra: ANU. ix+168 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: No language called Elpaputih; 'Elpaputi Bay' appears only as a place name (scanned ll. 7176, 7787). Amahai and Paulohi treated as separate languages of the Elpaputih Bay coast; no stress statement for Amahai found by a full-text search for stress/accent.

sources.citation: Collins, James T. 1982. Linguistic Research in Maluku: A Report of Recent Field Work. Oceanic Linguistics 21(1/2):73-146.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); access check: a digital copy exists, behind a library sign-in (also a publisher record (DOI), probably paywalled)
sources.note: One of the two surveys on which the retirement of [elp] rests; would confirm first-hand that no Elpaputih variety exists and may carry phonological notes on Amahai/Paulohi. Does not contain a stress statement for 'Elpaputih'.
